title: Coulthart: Republican presidents briefed, Democrats not

tellings.quote: Ross Coulthart recently came out and talked about how there sometimes seems to be a contrast between Republican presidents getting information and Democrat presidents not.

plain: Republican presidents are said to sometimes get briefed on the UFO secret while Democratic presidents do not. A researcher named Jason Simosa passes this on from Ross Coulthart, who has spoken publicly on the subject. Simosa says Coulthart "recently came out and talked about how there sometimes seems to be a contrast" between the two parties' presidents, which, if true, would mean that who gets told depends on politics.
